title: Huge Iceberg Could Threaten Penguins in the South Atlantic Ocean
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: Scientists are worried that a large iceberg heading toward an island in the South Atlantic Ocean could threaten wildlife there.
sentences.zh: 科学家们担心 向南大西洋一个岛屿移动的大冰山 可能会威胁到那里的野生动物

sentences.en: Researchers say the iceberg is the largest in the world.
sentences.zh: 研究人员说冰山是世界上最大的冰山

sentences.en: It is moving through the South Atlantic toward the island of South Georgia.
sentences.zh: 它正在穿越南大西洋 向南乔治亚岛移动

sentences.en: The island is a British overseas territory that is about 1,400 kilometers east of the Falkland Islands.
sentences.zh: 该岛是英国海外领土,位于福克兰群岛以东约1 400公里。

sentences.en: Scientists say South Georgia is a main mating ground for wildlife, especially penguins and seals.
sentences.zh: 科学家说南乔治亚是野生生物的主要交配地 特别是企鹅和海豹

sentences.en: The iceberg is officially known as A23a and it measures about 3,500 square kilometers.
sentences.zh: 冰山被正式称为A23a,面积约3,500平方公里。

sentences.en: It has existed since 1986, when it broke off from the Antarctic shelf .
sentences.zh: 它自1986年从南极大陆架断裂以来就一直存在。

sentences.en: Andrew Meijers is an oceanographer with the British Antarctic Survey.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁·梅耶斯是英国南极调查局的海洋学家。

sentences.en: He told the French News Agency (AFP) that scientists have been using satellite imagery to follow the iceberg’s movements.
sentences.zh: 他告诉法国通讯社(AFP),科学家们一直在利用卫星图像跟踪冰山的动向。

sentences.en: Meijers said observations had shown the iceberg had not broken into smaller pieces like some other so-called "megabergs" that passed through the Southern Ocean.
sentences.zh: Meijers说,观察显示冰山没有像 穿越南大洋的其他所谓的“海象”那样 破碎成小块。

sentences.en: He added that predicting the iceberg’s exact path is difficult.
sentences.zh: 他补充说,很难预测冰山的确切路径。

sentences.en: But ocean conditions suggest it should reach South Georgia in two to four weeks.
sentences.zh: 但海洋条件表明 它应该在两到四周内到达南乔治亚

sentences.en: Meijers said he is worried the iceberg will get caught on the underground continental shelf around South Georgia.
sentences.zh: Meijers说,他担心冰山 会被困在南乔治亚的地下大陆架上

sentences.en: But he said it is also possible the large ice mass could miss the shelf and continue moving into open waters beyond South Georgia.
sentences.zh: 但是他说大块的冰块 也可能错过了架子 继续移动到南乔治亚岛以外的开阔水域

sentences.en: If the iceberg does get caught, or stuck, on the shelf, Meijers said it could remain there for months or it could break into pieces.
sentences.zh: Meijers说如果冰山真的被抓住 或者被卡在架子上 它可以在那里呆上几个月 或者被撕成碎片

sentences.en: Meijers is concerned that this could harm efforts by penguins and seals on the island to feed and raise their young.
sentences.zh: Meijers担心这可能会损害岛上企鹅和海豹喂养和抚养幼童的努力。

sentences.en: Icebergs that have grounded there in the past led to the deaths of young penguins and seals, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说,过去在那里禁足的冰山导致年轻的企鹅和海豹死亡。

sentences.en: Raul Cordero is a mechanical engineer from Chile's University of Santiago.
sentences.zh: Raul Cordero是智利圣地亚哥大学的机械工程师。

sentences.en: He is also a member of the National Antarctic Research Committee.
sentences.zh: 他还是国家南极研究委员会的成员。

sentences.en: Cordero told AFP he thinks the iceberg will miss South Georgia.
sentences.zh: Cordero告诉AFP 他觉得冰山会想念南乔治亚州

sentences.en: "The island acts as an obstacle for ocean currents and therefore usually diverts the water long before it reaches the island," he said.
sentences.zh: 他说,“该岛是洋流的障碍,因此通常在水到达该岛之前很久就将水分流。

sentences.en: "The iceberg is moved by that water flow, so the chances of it hitting are not that high." Cordero added, however, that some iceberg pieces could affect the island.
sentences.zh: 冰山被水流移动,因此撞击的机会不是那么高。Cordero补充说,有些冰山碎片可能会影响该岛。

sentences.en: Soledad Tiranti is a glacier expert who is currently on an Argentinian exploration trip in the Antarctic.
sentences.zh: Soledad Tiranti是一位冰川专家,

sentences.en: She told AFP that icebergs such as A23a "are so deep that before reaching an island or mainland they generally get stuck" on the seabed.
sentences.zh: 她告诉菲律宾武装部队说,A23a这样的冰山“在到达一个岛屿或大陆之前很深,通常会卡在海底”。

sentences.en: It is currently summer in South Georgia and penguins and seals from the area have been looking for food in the cold Antarctic waters to bring back to their young.
sentences.zh: 现在是南乔治亚的夏季 该地区的企鹅和海豹 一直在寻找食物 在寒冷的南极水域

sentences.en: Meijers said the animals might have to go around the iceberg if it gets stuck.
sentences.zh: Meijers说如果被卡住了 动物可能得绕过冰山

sentences.en: He added that if they had to move around it, this would take a lot of their energy, possibly leading to animal deaths.
sentences.zh: 他补充说,如果他们不得不移动 周围,这将需要很多的精力, 可能导致动物死亡。

sentences.en: The seal and penguin populations on South Georgia have already been having a "bad season" with cases of bird flu, Meijers said.
sentences.zh: Meijers指出, 南乔治亚的海豹和企鹅群已经面临禽流感的“坏季节”。

sentences.en: Iceberg A23a remained stuck for 30 years before finally breaking free from the Antarctic shelf in 2020.
sentences.zh: Iceberg A23a被困了30年,2020年终于从南极大陆架上解脱出来。

sentences.en: Scientists watching its movements say the iceberg has followed nearly the same path as other large ice masses in the past.
sentences.zh: 观察冰山运动的科学家们说 冰山过去走过与其他大冰块差不多的道路

sentences.en: The icebergs generally pass the east side of the Antarctic Peninsula through the Weddell Sea along a path known as "iceberg alley ." They are pushed by the world’s most powerful ocean current system, the Antarctic Circumpolar Current.
sentences.zh: 冰山通常穿过南极半岛东面的韦德尔海,沿着一条被称为“冰山小巷”的道路。 它们被世界上最强大的洋流系统 — — 南极北极洋流所推动。

sentences.en: I’m Bryan Lynn. Agence France-Presse reported on this story.
sentences.zh: 我是Bryan Lynn,法国新闻社报导了此事。

sentences.en: Bryan Lynn adapted the report for VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: Bryan Lynn改编了VOA学习英语的报告。
